articleTitle: A New Feature Pyramid Network for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high computational cost based on deep backbones (e.g., ResNet-50, ResNet-101, DenseNet-169) in the state-of-the-art method about object detector, this paper improves the capability of feature representations by using New Feature Pyramid module on the basis of fast lightweight backbone network (vgg-16), and finally establishes a fast and accurate detector. The architecture of our model is named New FPN (New Feature Pyramid Network). Based on the structure of Feature Pyramid Network, we design a novel New Feature Pyramid Network, which consists of a combination of top-down and bottom-up connections to fuse features across scales, and achieves high-level semantic feature map at all scales. The experimental results show that New FPN achieves state-of-the-art detection accuracy (i.e. 79.2%mAP) on PASCAL VOC 2007 with high efficiency (i.e. 73FPS).

articleTitle: Research on Stock Price Prediction Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of the financial industry and the financial market, effectively improve the rate of return on funds and avoid market risks, this paper proposes a stock price prediction model based on convolution neural network, which has obvious self-adaptability and self-learning ability. Combining the characteristics of CNN (Convolution Neural Network) and Thai stock market, the data set is trained and tested after pretreatment. On this basis, three stocks (BBL, CAPLL&PTT) listed on the Thai Stock Exchange are tested and compared with the actual stock price. The results show that the model based on CNN can effectively identify the changing trend of stock price and predict it which can provide valuable reference for stock price forecast. The prediction accuracy is high, and it is worth further promotion in the financial field.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Internet of Things Security Architecture and Protection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is a fusion of industrial automation systems and IoT systems. It features comprehensive sensing, interconnected transmission, intelligent processing, self-organization and self-maintenance. Its applications span intelligent transportation, smart factories, and intelligence. Many areas such as power grid and intelligent environment detection. With the widespread application of IIoT technology, the cyber security threats to industrial IoT systems are increasing day by day, and information security issues have become a major challenge in the development process. In order to protect the industrial IoT system from network attacks, this paper aims to study the industrial IoT information security protection technology, and the typical architecture of industrial Internet of things system, and analyzes the network security threats faced by industrial Internet of things system according to the different levels of the architecture, and designs the security protection strategies applied to different levels of structures based on the specific means of network attack.

articleTitle: Application of NB-IoT in Intelligent Fire Protection System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: NB-IoT refers to a cellular-based narrowband Internet of Things, which has become an important part of the Internet of Things. NB-IoT is a new technology emerging in the field of Internet of Things in recent years. It has obvious advantages in technology and application. In addition, the application of narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) technology in the field of fire protection can fundamentally enhance the combat capability of fire fighting forces, avoid fire and reduce the loss of life and property of the people. This thesis analyses and introduces an intelligent fire-fighting system based on the new industry standard, and a smoke-fire detection and alarm device based on the Internet of Things (IoT) platform and Nb-IoT technology. It also puts forward corresponding solutions to the problem of smart smoke, such as the value, advantages and future expectations of the solution.

articleTitle: The College English Teaching Reform Supported by Multimedia Teaching Technology and Immersive Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, due to various reforms and developments, such as the reform of educational technology, the reform of the overall teaching mode, the reform of teaching methods, the improvement of teachers'comprehensive quality, etc., the important content of college English teaching reform under the current new situation has been created. Supported by multimedia teaching technology and immersive virtual reality technology, China will surely achieve the important goal of teaching reform. Immersion virtual English teaching environment refers to a new type of college English teaching environment under the modern mode. Its main purpose is to solve the current dilemma in the implementation of immersion English teaching. Supported by the current environment, the traditional immersion college English teaching mode can break through the constraints of time and space, and gradually become a new immersion college English teaching mode supported by high-end computer science and technology.

articleTitle: Improved Slip Mode Frequency-Shift Islanding Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the advantages of large output harmonics and complex algorithms of the islands effect detection algorithm in the photovoltaic power generation, based on the analysis of the principle of the sliding frequency shift ingress island detection method and the automatic phase island detection method, an improved sliding frequency shift ingress island detection method is proposed. Compared with the ordinary sliding frequency phase shift island detection algorithm (SMS) and automatic phase offset island detection algorithm (APS), this method has the characteristics of simple design idea and easy to achieve. The simulation design by PSIM shows that the method can accurately detect the occurrence of silos and effectively reduce the number of output harmonics, thus proving the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Advertising Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The current era is the information age and the digital age. It has many characteristics, such as experience, entertainment, intrusion and personalization. This also makes multimedia technology widely used in the field of advertising communication, and gradually changes people's way of production and life. Therefore, this paper first produced the concept of virtual reality technology, and analyzed the characteristics of virtual reality advertising, and also discussed the application of virtual reality technology in advertising communication, and studied the existing problems, so as to put forward feasible suggestions accordingly. In addition, this paper hopes to point out the future development prospects of advertising communication under virtual reality technology, so as to provide reference for a series of industrial processes in the advertising industry, such as design process and communication process.

articleTitle: Research on Panoramic Image Processing Technology Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a modern advanced computer simulation technology, which can build a super-compelling virtual environment and let users experience these virtual environments. Moreover, in this scenario, the simulation system of entity behavior can also make users feel really immersed in the virtual world. At the same time, the application of virtual reality technology has studied and developed a variety of technologies, such as computer image processing, computer simulation, sensors, etc. The feeling of freely communicating with things in a virtual environment. This topic mainly studies the important panoramic image processing technology in virtual reality technology, and elaborates and analyses the current mainstream panoramic processing algorithms in detail, and discusses the effect of these panoramic processing algorithms, hoping to give other experts and scholars who study virtual reality technology a little bit. Reference resources.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Application Automation Testing Technology Based on Appium
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of how to improve the quality of mobile applications and user experience continuously, and how to use automation testing technology rationally to avoid wasteful duplication of effort, a design method of the automation testing based on Appium is proposed. Appium is mainly aimed at the automation of user interface testing and business function and process testing. Appium is applicable to testing native, Web applications or hybrid mobile applications, and it is a cross-platform testing framework, which supports mobile application testing on iOS, Android and Firefox OS platforms. On Appium clients, automation testing scripts can be run to drive the automation testing, and Appium testing scripts can be written in Python, Ruby, C#, Java, Objective-C, JavaScript and other languages. The experimental results show that the proposed method of automation testing based on Appium can verify the mobile application software effectively, improve the testing efficiency and help enterprises save costs.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development Status of Artificial Intelligence Technology at Home and Abroad
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence will profoundly change human social life. Based on this background, this paper traces and studies the latest developments and application results in the field of international artificial intelligence, including the developments and achievements at the technical level, the development characteristics of the artificial intelligence market, the development trend of the application field of artificial intelligence and the competition pattern in the application field of artificial intelligence. For the innovation and development planning in the field of AI, the focus is on the outline of AI + traditional industry, accelerating the upgrading of industrial intelligence, building AI innovation plateau, building a safe and convenient intelligent society, etc. Finally, taking the traditional industry and the intelligent society as an example, the application of AI in related fields is expounded and prospected.

articleTitle: Iterative Encryption Method of Transmission Data Anti-Tampering Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the security of transmission data storage in supercomputer network, a supercomputer network transmission data encryption technology based on elliptical hyperbolic iterative coding is proposed. The elliptical hyperbolic differential equation is constructed, and the big data of the supercomputer network is loaded into the elliptical hyperbolic differential equation. A set of high-order statistical characteristic solutions describing the frequency of the quantitative coding symbol are obtained. The tamper-proof iterative encryption cipher design and the public key coding configuration are carried out. The random quantitative coding fusion method is used to carry out the tampering proof iteration of the computer network transmission data. The anti-tampering encryption, secure storage and transmission of data transmission in supercomputer network are realized under Logistics chaotic mapping system. The simulation results show that the encryption technology has good tamper proof performance, strong anti-attack ability and good secure transmission performance for supercomputer network transmission data encryption.

articleTitle: Research on Weapon and Equipment Requirement Analysis Method Based on DODAF
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The method of architecture is an effective way to analyze the requirements of weapons and equipment. DODAF (U.S. Department of Defense Architecture Framework) is a standard specification issued by the U.S. Department of Defense in 2004 to guide the generation of military equipment requirements. DODAF has been widely recognized as the standard of weapon equipment requirement description. This paper introduces the concepts of DODAF, analyze DoDAF function, structure and problems of DoDAF, and discusses the basic process of weapon loading requirement analysis based on DODAF method, providing a new scientific method for the analysis and research of weapons and equipment requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Virtual Pavilion Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) is today's cutting-edge technology and an emerging force driving economic, social and cultural development. VR technology builds virtual pavilions through computer-based collaboration, multi-channel user interface, 3D human-computer interaction, simulation system and other technical means to provide immersive, interactive, multi-perceive and all-round, multi-angle The viewing experience allows the audience to experience the most authentic feelings in the virtual pavilion environment. Compared with the traditional pavilion, the virtual pavilion has a huge technical advantage from static to dynamic, from single to multiple, from passive to interactive, and from offline to online. This paper analyzes the basic characteristics of VR technology such as immersion, interactivity and conception, and expounds the development status of virtual pavilion based on VR technology, pointing out that hardware technology needs to be improved, and the technology is still immature in the protection and development of non-legacy culture. In the commercial product display design and production, the cost is higher, the content is more single and so on. To comprehensively analyze the above problems, propose the path of virtual pavilion construction, such as: "people-oriented" design concept, technology and art integration, establish dynamic environment, real-time three-dimensional image generation and display, research and development of new interactive equipment, intelligent voice development, use Large-scale distributed network virtual reality, etc., and pointed out the future development trend of virtual pavilion immersed, interactive, information, and convenient, the theme and content of its exhibition will have a profound impact on people's thoughts and behaviors and lifestyle.

articleTitle: Big Data Security and Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the wide application and popularization of large data, more and more data security and privacy issues have brought great challenges to the development of large data. Starting from the characteristics of big data, this paper analyses various risks of information security, and puts forward the corresponding development strategy of big data security. The results show that the combination of technology and relevant policies and regulations can better solve the problem of big data security and privacy protection.

articleTitle: JSP-Based Pet Adoption System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The system is mainly divided into four modules: user handling module, pet handling module, pet adoption module and pet statistics module. Through Eclipse, MySql, etc., using SSM framework, bootstrap framework, various plug-ins and related JSP technology. Among them, the modal box in the bootstrap framework to reduce the number of JSP pages. When browsing pets, I chose a plug-in written in pure CSS to complete the waterfall stream layout for users to browse. In the adoption of pet statistics module, the plug-in provided by Echarts is used to complete the production of the chart, making the data look more vivid and more intuitive. It also provides the function of downloading the image to the local for administrators to download and use. When the user logs in, the user name of the user is determined according to the user name that is logged in, and the identity of the user is an ordinary member or an administrator, to identify the right and jump to the page corresponding to the permission. When you log in, you have the ability to remember your password; you can log in two functions to make the design more user-friendly.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Teaching Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, our country's economy is in the stage of rapid development and is developing towards industrialization and informatization. In addition, our society has put forward higher standards and requirements for personnel training and education, and our country is constantly vigorously training high-quality skilled personnel. At the same time, the demand for high-quality skilled personnel in various fields is also increasing. In addition, China has begun to encourage and support the development of vocational education from many aspects, vigorously carry out educational and teaching reform, so as to promote the formation and development of comprehensive vocational quality of our students. At the same time, as a major invention in the information technology era, virtual reality technology has frequently appeared in people's production and life, and has become a hot topic in the current education field, which provides a good basis for training high-quality skilled talents in our country. Therefore, in this paper, the concept of virtual reality technology is analyzed, and its application in accounting teaching is analyzed and discussed, hoping to give some reference to other researchers.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Privacy Security and Coping Strategies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of implicit security issues arising from the interconnected and the centralized management of data platforms in the IoT application system with the development of network intelligence and information technology, a design method of comprehensive privacy protection method is proposed. This method is focusing on the application security of the sensing layer and the transport layer, in the sensing layer, three factors including dedicated encryption chip, electronic key and hard disk data are combined for identity authentication, in terms of protection strategy, protect privacy with anonymization, lightweight encryption, routing protocol, etc. The experimental results show that the proposed method can prevent data leakage on related hardware effectively, and multiple security strategy can prevent data leakage in the process of transmission or at a node effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Insurance Survey Claims System Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the cumbersome procedures of insurance investigation and claim settlement and the difficulty of precise promotion of insurance services for specific customers, this paper proposes an insurance investigation and claim system based on big data analysis. This method is developed on the basis of agile model. It has case information management, investigation information management, claim settlement management, intelligent insurance recommendation, etc. Intelligent customer service and other core functions, relying on Web, mobile applications and social networks for data collection, filtering and real-time analysis of the collected large data information, using Hadoop framework to convert structured data into semi-structured or unstructured data, storage of data information, through advanced analysis, prediction model Type and visual query, mining and analyzing the extracted data, and finally displaying the results after analysis. The experimental results show that the insurance survey and claim system completes the business processing of one-click report, survey photos upload, efficient claim settlement and insurance recommendation, speeds up the claim processing speed, and realizes the personalized service and precise marketing of customer insurance.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Greenhouse Planting Management Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low efficiency management in the greenhouse, a design of intelligent robot used for strawberry field management is proposed based on the urgent situation of high efficiency strawberry greenhouse planting. The robot can move freely along the wide road of the strawberry greenhouse by a four-wheel mobile platform. At the same time, an automatic sprinkling pump with pesticide is designed, which can spray pesticide on each plant. The strawberry picking head with color recognition can identify ripe strawberries and it can pick strawberries. Manager can control the temperature and humidity by the remote control system of in the computer or telephone. The robot can pick the fruit and spray the pesticide by itself when it receives instructions. In the future, fruit planting industry will change the original planting way and realize the integrative management of harvesting, remote detection and other intelligent management.

articleTitle: Research on Automation Testing Technology Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of how to efficiently validate the software with graphical interface and avoid tedious duplication of work to save time and reduce costs, a design method of the automation testing based on image recognition is proposed. The automation testing based on image recognition can verify the appearance of page elements and the relative positions between elements effectively and can directly support the software testing in various operating systems. In the long time continuous testing, the automation testing based on image recognition is more reliable comparing with the automation testing based on identifying the object of the software under test. What's more, it has no special requirement for testers' programming ability. The experimental results show that the proposed method of automation testing based on image recognition testing has its unique advantages in software testing, which can effectively verify the software with graphical interface, improve testers' work efficiency and save costs to accelerate the iteration of software development and version.

articleTitle: A DSP48-Based Reconfigurable 2-D Convolver on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Two-dimensional (2-D) convolution is a widely used operator exploited in image processing and computer vision. Many schemes of the FPGA-based 2-D convolver are focused on the buffer scheme and computational complexity. This paper optimizes the convolution unit from a unique perspective - underlying resource utilization, and presents a novel reconfigurable 2-D convolver. The purpose of this structure is to probe into the internal structure and resources of DSP blocks in FPGA and give full play to their computing power to complete convolution. This 2-D convolver can greatly reduce the consumption of logic resources without sacrificing the equivalent performance of convolution. The experiment results also demonstrate that this structure presents considerable adaptability to different sizes of images and kernels, making it suitable for various FPGA implementations.

articleTitle: Whale Optimization Algorithm Improved Effectiveness Analysis Based on Compound Chaos Optimization Strategy and Dynamic Optimization Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Basing on the fact that the basic whale optimization algorithm has the defects including low convergence precision and it is easy to fall into the local optimal solution when solving the objective function whose optimal solution is not near the origin. A new whale optimization algorithm (Dio-WOA) based on compound chaos optimization strategy and dynamic improved parameters is proposed. In the algorithm, the chaos optimization strategy set is first introduced for multiple solution links. At the same time, the convergence factor of WOA a is improved and the inertia weight w is introduced, so the algorithm can slow down the convergence speed in the early stage for each generation to fully explore the overall algorithm and accelerate in the later iteration to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. At the same time, chaos strategy concentrates on the chaos optimization strategy for the optimal solution can help the algorithm effectively choose the solution out of the local optimal solution. This paper verifies the comprehensive performance of the Dio-WOA algorithm and the effectiveness of various improvement measures. Several undetermined dimension single-peak and multi-peak test functions are introduced to verify the performance of the overall algorithm and the local improvement algorithm. The results show that the single improvement measures can effectively improve the performance of the algorithm and each measure has different performance directions. The comprehensive performance of Dio-WOA is better than that of single improvement measures, which proves the effective compatibility between the improvement measures.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimizing Method of Question Answering System in Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Natural language processing technology can not only enrich the functions of computers, but also fundamentally promote the development of artificial intelligence technology. Based on natural language processing technology, many useful systems for people's survival and life have been produced, such as the question-and-answer system described in this thesis. This system mainly uses natural language processing technology and information retrieval technology. Although it is based on text retrieval, it is quite different from traditional search engine. Traditional search engines point out that users need to input a series of keyword combinations, and users can only get a variety of related websites, but also rely on their own discrimination ability to select useful information. However, the question answering system can allow users to input a question in the form of natural language. Finally, according to the search and judgment, the system can get a short and accurate answer to the user, which greatly improves the convenience of people's production and life. This thesis mainly elaborates the content of question answering system of natural language processing and analyses how to optimize it.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Oral English Teaching in College Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The main feature of language teaching is that it requires a high learning environment and builds a specific language environment for students, so as to enable them to improve the oral English teaching effect scientifically and efficiently in a good language environment. However, not every student can really integrate into the English environment. At present, with the continuous development of science and technology, it has also begun to be applied to oral English teaching, which fundamentally changes the rapid development of science and technology. At the same time, it has gradually been applied to the field of oral English teaching in an all-round way, making oral English teaching easier. In this paper, the concept of it is analyzed in detail. After that, this paper points out that the current it has been combined with the teaching mode, and has broken through the traditional teaching mode. Finally, this paper also analyses and discusses the significance of it in college oral English teaching, and points out that it has brought great significance to college oral English teaching.

articleTitle: Patent Protection for Artificial Intelligence in China
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To stimulate the incentives for AI-related innovations, China revised its Examination Guidelines for Patents, which came into force from 2017. The updated guidelines stipulate that if a invention relating to computer program or business model includes a technical feature, it should not be excluded from being patent eligible. Four types of claims, which are method, program module, computer system and storage media, are provided to protect the invention patent application on the computer program processing flow based on the amendment. Since artificial intelligence related inventions include methods for implementing mental steps using computers and devices designed to automate mental activities, the implicit requirements for judging patent eligibility may be inconsistent with the nature of artificial intelligence technology. In order to enhance the possibility of patent entitled of artificial intelligence related inventions, patent applicants should concentrate on their construction of the claims to indicate what technical problems the invention are solving or identify the specific improvements made by the claims.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Intelligent Inspection and Replacement System of TBM Excavation Tools
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the health and safety of the manual tool change during the excavation process of the TBM and to save the long maintenance time causing the high productivity and associated costs, the paper puts forward the scheme of that advanced intelligent control techniques such as flexible robots and multi-axis robots can be used to realize unmanned and smart inspection and excavation tools replacement. The scheme includes a snake robot for inspection of excavation chamber and a multi-axis robot for the replacement of the disc cutters. Based on this scheme, a set of prototypes and experimental devices for verifying key technologies have been designed, and the experiments of the prototypes on the experimental devices have accomplished. The experimental results show the scheme that the inspection robot and the replacement robot can be used to replace the manpower in the TBM maintenance work is feasible. Through the application of smart devices and new technologies, the technical level of the TBM can be effectively improved, and the health impact on the operators can be reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Collection Method of Financial Blockchain Risk Prompt Information from Sandbox Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the low accuracy of the current collection method of financial blockchain risk prompt information, the collection method of financial blockchain risk prompt information under the sandbox view threshold is proposed. Under the sandbox vision, the parser parses the URL of financial blockchain risk prompt message and USES the buron filtering algorithm to de-weight the URL. The URL after weight removal is added into the library to be crawled, and the crawling URL is clustered by using the clustering algorithm to calculate the similarity between URL and noise URL in the cluster, and the URL with high similarity is removed. The web crawler collects the URL queue after denoising, saves the collected URL to the database, and runs the URL resolution program to complete the collection of risk warning information. Through the comparison test with the current information collection method, it proves that the designed method of financial block chain risk prompt information collection under the sandbox vision threshold has higher collection accuracy and advantages.

articleTitle: Research on Heilongjiang Supply Chain Finance Development Model Based on Fast k-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to further tap Heilongjiang's financial market and stabilize the economic environment. A supply chain finance development model of Heilongjiang Province based on fast k-nearest neighbor algorithm is proposed. By calculating the current financial circulation coefficient of Heilongjiang supply chain, investigating the market share and potential mining ability of local supply chain, and combining the fast k-nearest neighbor algorithm to calculate the development potential of supply chain finance, the research on the development mode of Heilongjiang supply chain finance is realized. Finally, the experiment proves that the research method of Heilongjiang supply chain finance development model based on fast k-nearest neighbor algorithm has higher practicability and accuracy than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Campus Multimedia Interactive System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to perfect the construction of intelligent campus multimedia interactive information network and improve the ability of campus multimedia interaction and intelligent education information management, a design scheme of intelligent campus multimedia interactive system based on Internet of things technology is proposed. The system development environment is based on Multigen Creator3.2 and embedded PCI bus development environment, and the intelligent campus multimedia interactive infrastructure is constructed by using Internet of things and radio frequency identification (RFID) construction scheme. The virtual scene simulation and multimedia information interaction design of multimedia information platform, intelligent classroom, library interactive platform and student information management system are realized on the intelligent multimedia information processing terminal to meet the needs of multimedia interaction in intelligent campus. The hardware structure and software development of the intelligent campus multimedia interactive system are carried out. the test results show that the system has high information integration and strong multimedia information processing ability. The artificial intelligence is good, the system is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Intellectual Property Protection for AI-Related Inventions in Japan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To increase the possibility of patent entitled of artificial intelligence related inventions at the Japanese patent office, this paper analyzes the Japanese patent act and patent examination guidelines. The approach for assessing whether a computer related invention belongs to a eligible subject-matter includes two steps. The first step is whether a computer related invention meets the definition of an "invention" that is "creation of a technical idea utilizing the laws of nature" . The second step is whether a computer related invention meets "idea based on the standpoint of software" . From the perspective of patent analysis, Japan's artificial intelligence technology is leading the world, second only to the United States. In this field, the Japanese patent office is one of the most important intellectual property offices, and its legislation and practice of patent eligibility review for artificial intelligence related inventions have an important impact on the world.

articleTitle: Maximum Lifetime Optimized Collaboration of Data and Energy Routing in VANET
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The roadside units (RSUs) based on traditional grid has high carbon footprint and high deployment cost in vehicle dedicated network. An ideal green alternative has become an important issue in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs). In this paper, we propose a novel framework of energy harvesting and cooperation to maximize the life cycle in VENETs. In this VANET scenario, the RSU node can harvest energy from the nature and also receive down steam vehicle energy dispatch to maintain the energy needed for data transmission, may transfers a portion of obtained energies by RSU nodes to the neighboring RSU nodes through energy cooperation. Each vehicle can access the RSU in two ways: 1) direct delivery when the vehicle is within the transmission range of the RSU; 2) multi-hop relay when the vehicle is not within the transmission range of the RSU. By analysing the data rate, transmission power and energy transmission, we solve the problem of maximum network life cycle in the conservation law of energy and traffic. We consider involving energy constraints and data transmission joint problem, we optimize each RUS nodes energy management over vehicular outgoing data links and its energy transfers to neighboring RSU nodes. For this case, with no energy cooperation, we show that each RSU node should allocate more power to links with more noise and/or more data flow. In addition, when there is energy cooperation, our numerical results indicate that the energy is routed from nodes with higher energy to nodes with lower energy. Simulation results show that energy and data routing cooperation in VANET strategy can effectively improve the network life cycle.

Author Keywords: Road side units, Energy harvesting, data and energy routing cooperation, life cycle

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Disassemble and Assemble System for Screw Compressor Based on Unity 3D
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of air-conditioning enterprises, some difficulty exists in the training of professional ability for enterprise staff and college students in vocational colleges. Such as inadequate teaching interaction, long training cycle and high cost. Virtual disassemble and assemble technology relies on virtual reality, multimedia, computer information processing and other technologies, which can play a unique role in equipment development, maintenance and later training & teaching. Based on the actual size of the equipment, a three-dimensional model is established. According to the standard disassemble process, automatic disassemble and manual disassemble are carried out step by step, which can lay a foundation for the maintenance and operation of compressor system equipment. It can also be combined with physical equipment to carry out virtual operation simulation teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the Problems and Countermeasures of College-Enterprise Cooperation in Higher Vocational Colleges Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, China's education has begun to gradually promote diversified development. Vocational education is an important component of China's education, which plays an important role in China's education. In recent years, China's vocational education is in the stage of rapid development, and has also delivered a large number of excellent technical talents to enterprises. At present, under normal circumstances, higher vocational colleges at home and abroad adopt the mode of school-enterprise cooperation to train technical talents. In the process of training our country's technical talents, a series of problems have arisen. These problems have the same points. The main problems are that many higher vocational colleges do not attach enough importance to school-enterprise cooperation, do not construct a suitable mechanism for training talents, have few opportunities for training inside and outside schools, and lag behind the base facilities for training talents. In view of the above problems, higher vocational colleges must take reasonable measures in time, adhere to the teaching mode of school-enterprise cooperation, highlight the characteristics of professional technology training and strengthen practical training between school-enterprise cooperation. Only in this way can we ensure that in the current era of rapid development of information technology, the talents trained by higher vocational colleges can better meet the employment needs of enterprises and realize the scientificity and practicability of engineering and technical personnel training as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Statistically Analysis for the Stability of Various Protection Modes of Expansive Soil Cutting Slope
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Expansive soils are widely distributed in southwest of China and are used frequently in highway construction. The stability of protection mode for expansive soil cutting slope is widely concerned by engineers. Through a large number of field research, laboratory tests, test section construction and monitoring, especially the use of statistical analysis, this research identified the most suitable protection mode is arch skeleton for expansive soil cutting slope of highway. According to the logistic regression, t-test, and other statistical analysis results, this study concluded that the slope stability rate reached 86.84% after protection with arch skeleton. Therefore, arch skeleton is significantly better than other modes of protection, p=0.0581. In addition, this study found that the height and slope rate had a great influence on the stability of expansive soil cutting slope. It is recommended that the slope rate of expansive soil cutting slope should not be steeper than 1:1.5 and the slope height should not exceed 6m.

articleTitle: Intelligent Logistics Management Application Relying on The Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology effectively supports the upgrading of traditional logistics to smart logistics, and realizes the fundamental requirements for cost reduction and efficiency improvement in the logistics industry. However, at present, there are still many problems such as low logistics efficiency and high cost in the construction of logistics public information platform, coordinated development of the terminal, and construction of government platforms. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent logistics management application based on the Internet of Things. This model has good applicability in information sharing, resource utilization synergy and supply chain integration, and has a significant effect on promoting the development of smart logistics. The development of high-end technologies such as intelligence and blockchain has been further upgraded.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Disassembly System of Front Pump Based on Unity-3d
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Based on the virtual disassembly technology extended by virtual reality technology in the field of mechanical design and manufacturing, many experiments do not allow students to operate freely for various reasons, but are not affected in the computer. Since the training of employees in thermal power plants is generally based on the mentoring system, the training period is long and the effect is slow, so the virtual pump is used to model the front pump and build the fault library, including common mechanical faults, electrical fault types and disposal. The way to build the database, so that the new factory personnel can quickly master the system, thus saving manpower training costs. In the design process, 3D MAX, Unity, Visual Studio and other software were used to design the 3D graphics and disassemble the process according to the equipment standard, and the virtual simulation teaching can be combined with the physical equipment.

articleTitle: Exploration on Bilingual Education of Digital Communication Theory in the Background of International Engineering Education Accreditation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to cultivate professional graduate students with the view of internationalization and development, this paper has explored the bilingual education reform of one of the most important courses of the electronic information major, digital communication theory. Firstly, this paper analyzes the key issues that need to be solved in the bilingual education reform of digital communication theory course with the consideration of the course's feature, and characteristics of school and students. And then, the objectives of bilingual education of digital communication theory have been analyzed in details. Finally, on the basis of the existing syllabus of digital communication theory, the teaching administrative processes and specific teaching methodologies are proposed for class teaching, after class study, bilingual teaching. The proposed teaching system can improve students' ability of learning theoretical knowledge, analyzing engineering problems, and tracking cutting-edge technology. The implementation of bilingual education of digital communication theory helps to cultivate high-level professional talents with global views, systematic theory and engineering knowledge.

articleTitle: Research on Network Privacy Information Security Management Method Based on NoSQL Database
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to better guarantee the security of network privacy information, a method of network privacy information security management based on NoSQL database is proposed. Firstly, the network privacy information security status is detected and evaluated based on the principle of neural network. According to the evaluation results, the network privacy information encryption processing method is optimized, and the intensity of information encryption is strengthened to achieve the management of network privacy information security. Finally, the experiment proves that the NoSQL database-based network privacy information security management method has higher security and effectiveness than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Practice of a New Model Fusion Structure in Short Video Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In recent years, the popular short video content understanding and recommendation technology has become a research hotspot. This paper presents a new mixed short video recommendation algorithm based on the content, the use of FM, FMM, DeepFM DeepDCN model) and the short video content (visual, text, user interaction), and other characteristics of the training, at the same time, using a combination of two hybrid model of strategy for learning, for users to return to a short video recommend high quality results. In order to evaluate the proposed algorithm, experiments were carried out on the short video content understanding and recommendation competition data set on Biendata open competition platform, which was derived from the TikTok (douyin overseas edition) short video APP owned by bytedance company, which included two tracks: yayi and yayi. Participants were asked to model a user's interest through a video and user interaction data set, and then predict the user's click behavior on another video data set. Based on the analysis of root race results, the algorithm proposed in this paper effectively improves the performance of short video recommendation algorithm.

Author Keywords: FM, FFM, DeepFM, DCN, Model fusion

articleTitle: Design of Multi-network Data Acquisition System Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper describes the construction of the multi-network data acquisition system monitored by cloud platform. The system takes STM32F4 as the system control core platform. In the Intranet mode, data collection is carried out through a variety of network methods, including ZigBee network, Nrf24L01 radio frequency network, bluetooth network, etc. The data collected by each network is received and sent to the core platform through the receiving end. After the data is processed by STM32F4, all data are uniformly sent from the WIFI module to the cloud for data storage. Users can monitor the data through mobile phones and PCS. In multi-network data networking, sensor nodes are more flexible in addition and deletion, the network layout can be adapted to local conditions according to actual needs, and the external output of data is all achieved through the TCP/IP protocol to achieve the integration of multiple networks. Through the actual measurement, the data monitoring through cloud platform is realized, with high real-time data update and stable transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture of Intelligent Command and Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As the nerve center of the combat system, command and control system plays the role of the combat intelligence brain. Its intellectualization is the key to enhance the core competitiveness of the military field. Intelligent development of command and control is the general trend. In the basis of Artificial Intelligence, this paper describes the definition and key technologies of intelligent command and control system, and puts forward a command and control system architecture model with service as granularity, data as center and artificial intelligence as grasp based on military cloud brain. which provides basic theory and technical support for the future development of intelligent command and control system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition Method of Fuzzy Features of Surveillance Video Image Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high error rate of fuzzy feature extraction in monitoring video image based on traditional fuzzy BP fuzzy feature extraction method, a fuzzy feature extraction algorithm for monitoring video image based on big data is proposed. The matched filtering method is used to reduce the noise of the monitored video image, the adaptive association rule learning algorithm is used to construct the fuzzy feature large data set, and the edge profile feature detection algorithm is used for feature decomposition. The key action point fusion method is used to enhance the fuzzy information of the monitored video image, and the region equivalent histogram of the monitored video image is extracted. The extracted gray histogram is input into the BP neural network fuzzy feature extractor, and the adaptive association rule learning algorithm is used to optimize the monitoring video image feature clustering in the hidden layer of the fuzzy feature extractor. The fuzzy feature extraction and optimization of batch monitoring video image is realized. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good accuracy, strong ability to resist inter-class attribute disturbance, and high recall rate of monitoring video image output. The time cost of fuzzy feature extraction for monitoring video image is small.

articleTitle: Apply Intelligent Assembly in the Cosmetic Flexible Production
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of automatic production of cosmetics, few volume, huge variation, and the yield rate is low, design method based on the interactive application of molds and tools in elastic production is proposed. This research is based on the relevant research and analysis of existing products to develop an innovative production sequence process in assembly. This study applies the electrical control system and platform structure design to the traditional site production process to achieve the purpose of automated production. By adjusting the number of automatic gluing heads and various jigs in the carrier design, it can be replaced according to design needs to realize the advantages of diversified flexible production. The experimental results show that the method has the characteristics of elastic line changing performance, low defect rate and high production efficiency, which lays a foundation for further application of elastic production automation.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Formation Network Technology in High Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Formations are the main form of UAV cooperative operation, and UAV ad hoc network is an effective technique to achieve the formation control. Additionally, clustering techniques are important to manage and control UAV ad hoc networks. Therefore, the paper aiming at the special environment of UAV networking in mountainous and jungle area and the requirement of flexible and dynamic networking, a high dynamic self-organizing UAV network architecture design based on cluster is proposed. we will fully consider the situation of the mobile network, and propose the concrete plan for the management of non-human computer network, namely the switching of the nodes in the two modes of the node, and the design of the switching mode of the network mode. which can meet the requirements of various UAV autonomous cooperative formation networking under high dynamic environment, and improve the communication performance and intelligent decision-making ability of UAV formation networking.

articleTitle: Research on House Recommendation Model Based on Cosine Similarity in Deep Learning Mode in Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the current number of recommended models in the house recommendation system model, the recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction do not meet the needs of users, this paper proposes a house recommendation model based on cosine similarity in the deep learning mode in grid environment. The model first uses the established grid environment, combined with the deep learning mode, through the collection of a large number of housing basic data samples and user feedback information, establishes a mathematical model of housing recommendation, and then integrates the cosine similarity into the recommendation model, through training and parameters. Adjust the model framework gradually. Finally, through the derivation and verification of the simulation experiment, the proposed recommendation model can efficiently recommend the housing information that meets the requirements for the user, and improve the recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Method of Piano Teaching Resources Based on Multiple Logical Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the classification of piano teaching resources is not effective at present, a research on the classification method of piano teaching resources based on multiple logistic regression is proposed. Firstly, different characteristic categories in piano teaching resources are collected and extracted. Combined with multiple logistic regression classification algorithms, different characteristic factors in teaching materials are classified into categories and sequences, and finally the reasonable classification of piano teaching resources is realized. Finally, the experiment proves that the classification method of piano teaching resources based on multiple logistic regression is more practical and effective than the traditional classification method.

articleTitle: Research on the Artistic Characteristics of VR Films
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: From 2D to 3D, to VR, every innovation in film technology has opened up a new field for the artistic creation of film. VR film is an immersive, interactive and multi-perceived film created by VR technology. As a new form of film art, it attracts the attention of the audience and naturally brings the audience into the scene of the story. Make the audience the main body of the story. The emergence of VR movies has subverted the traditional movie viewing mode to a certain extent, bringing a new viewing experience to the audience. This paper analyzes the artistic characteristics of VR movies, and discusses the advantages and disadvantages: the lens language of VR movies, the richness of 360-degree scene elements and the immersive experience all lay a good foundation for the development of VR movies. basis. However, compared with traditional movies, VR movie plot design is relatively simple, the weakening of montage techniques and the dizziness and discomfort brought by VR headsets have become the limiting factors of VR movies. Technology production has become the main reason for restricting the development of VR movies. However, as a new technical means, VR technology has expanded the new artistic creation concept of the film, promoted the deep integration of art and technology, and enhanced the immersive and interactive experience of the film. In summary, in the future, VR film art creation should describe the story in a new VR lens language, scientifically and rationally arrange the story structure; pay attention to the user experience, give the audience a variety of sensory experiences through interactive design, and create a better immersive viewing experience. Improve the artistic creation and production capacity of film and promote the further development of VR film.

articleTitle: Rationality Evaluation of Art Furniture Layout Based on Scene Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inaccurate evaluation of art furniture layout at present, the rationality evaluation method of art furniture layout based on scenario simulation is proposed. Firstly, the rationality index of artistic furniture spatial layout is calculated. According to the calculation results, the spatial layout of artistic furniture is simulated by combining geographic information system technology. According to the simulation results, judgment is made, and the evaluation grade of the rationality index of artistic furniture layout is divided. According to the divided evaluation grades, judge its rationality, and finally realize the quasi-evaluation of the rationality of artistic furniture layout. Finally, the experiment proves that the rationality evaluation result of artistic furniture layout based on scenario simulation is more accurate and effective than the traditional evaluation method.

articleTitle: The Research of the Feature Extraction and Classification Algorithm Based on EEG Signal of Motor Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: BCI based on machine learning could makes use of the egg signals to communicate to output under the condition of without the participation of peripheral nerves and muscles. Extracting the essential features of the EEG signals in the presence of artifacts, training the classification algorithms and optimalizing the performance of classifier is critical procedure for BCI system. To some extent the BCI system can be treated as a pattern recognition system whose performance depends on both the features extraction and the features classification algorithm employed. Independent component analysis (ICA) can remove the artifact in the electroencephalogram (EEG) signal spontaneous evoked by left and right hand motor imagery and the classifier based on the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm and on the common spatial pattern (CSP) algorithm apply the feature extracted from purified EEG signal to recognize and discriminate distinctive motor imagery pattern.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Sided Combined Forecasting Method of Economic Supply and Demand Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of traditional forecasting methods, this paper studies the combination forecasting of economic supply and demand based on large data analysis. Preprocessing the supply and demand data of historical economy which may be abnormal, wrong and missing. The processed data are input into BP neural network and GM model as input data. Through the training of BP neural network and the processing of GM model, set parameters. The annealing algorithm is used to calculate the combination weight. According to the combination weight, the BP neural network and GM model are linearly combined to complete the design of the two-sided combination forecasting method for economic supply and demand. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the traditional prediction method is about 6/7 of that of the proposed method, and the prediction accuracy is significantly improved.

Author Keywords: both sides of economic supply and demand

articleTitle: Construction of College Student Data Information Management System Based on Association Rule Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the insufficiency that the construction of the college student data management system cannot be processed based on the evidence theory, a kind of method for the construction of the college student data management system that is dependent on the association rule algorithm is put forward in this paper, which aims to solve the problems in the construction of the college student data management system and so on. Based on the association rule algorithm, the pre-processing of the college student data management system is established. In addition, dependent on the characteristics of the association rule algorithm, the related centroid is calculated, and the centroid is taken as the representative information of the cluster. The basic probability assignment is carried out in accordance with the generalized triangular fuzzy membership function, and the evidence is formed after the assignment, thus completing the construction of the college student data management system. The simulation results show that the method put forward in this paper is effective and can be used to carry out reasonable evaluation on the college student data management system.

articleTitle: Design of Rope-Driven Manipulator with Three Fingers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex structure, heavy weight and difficult manufacturing of manipulator, a design scheme of rope-driven three-fingered manipulator is proposed based on bionics principle to meet different functional requirements. The actual motion of the manipulator is controlled by the cable drive and the bending of the distal knuckle is realized by coupling connection. The three-dimensional solid model of the manipulator is established by using the design software, and the motion simulation analysis of the solid model is carried out to obtain its motion law. The results of motion analysis show that the speed of the manipulator changes smoothly in the motion process, and the change of speed has little effect on the stability of the objects grasped by the manipulator. Finally, a prototype of the manipulator is made according to the design results. The prototype model can be used not only in practical teaching, but also in theoretical research. It can provide some reference for the practical application of multi-fingered and multi-joint manipulators.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Decision Support Software
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at overcoming the limitations of artificial intelligence (AI) and decision support system (DSS), not expressing complex decision-making process, a scheme of decision support system based on data mining is proposed after introducing the definition. The method is based on the characteristics of decision support system of artificial intelligence technology, realizes the system platform with MATLAB programming tool in which the association rule algorithm based on decision tree is implemented, and gives the concrete structure. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme and implementation platform have good passability and can provide a good platform for further research on new data mining algorithms.The validity and practicability of the improved algorithm and platform are further verified multi-attribute decision making based on calyx confirmation population problem.

articleTitle: Establishment of Cross-Border e-Commerce Transaction Credit Control Platform Based on Wireless Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of traditional e-commerce transaction credit management and control on transaction credit management, a cross-border e-commerce transaction credit management and control platform is built based on wireless network technology. The hardware module composed of CC2340 chip and its surrounding circuit is used to realize the wireless transmission of data. Build the software module of the platform on the physical server. Web mining method is used to collect credit log data. The collected credit data is transferred to the data processing module through the data transmission module. In the data processing module, data are filtered according to the set credit filtering parameters. Use SQL language in SQL database, clean according to data weight. The cleaned data is sent to the database for data management. Completed the construction of the trading credit control platform by building the hardware and software modules of the platform. Compared with the traditional credit management and control platform, the efficiency of transaction credit management and control of the platform is verified. Experimental results: the efficiency of the established credit control platform for transaction credit control is 87.56% on average, which is one third higher than the efficiency of traditional platform.

articleTitle: Power Marketing Big Data Precision User Profile
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the new market competition environment, grid companies are shifting from traditional passive and extensive management services to active and innovative marketing services, a power marketing user profile model method is proposed, which is based on the classic RFM user value model, analyzes the relevant characteristics that affect the user value of power payment, and extracts the five characteristics of C, R, F, M and O to construct the CRFMO power payment user value model. Secondly, the K-Means clustering algorithm is used to group users to realize user profile. The experimental results show that the model method lays the foundation for the power company to effectively mine user power payment information, extract user value, and formulate corresponding marketing strategies and provide differentiated services.

articleTitle: Research on Pest and Disease Recognition Algorithms Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to detect crop diseases and insect pests in crop cultivation timely and accurately and to determine which kind of diseases and insect pests, this paper uses some algorithms in the field of image processing and the prevailing neural network to identify crop diseases and insect pests. In order to better identify diseases and insect pests, this paper uses a variety of plant diseases and insect pests for analysis and research, then expands a variety of crop diseases and insect pests on the original basis, expands the practical field by modifying model parameters and other methods, which not only saves workload, but also saves a lot of time, and can be based on the original. Real-time conditions to make a better pest identification algorithm model.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-level Distributed Storage Method of Economic and Financial Management Database
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the security of economic financial management data storage, a multi-level distributed storage encryption algorithm of economic financial management database based on piecewise fusion encryption and information clustering is proposed. Under the arithmetic coding key encryption system, the data distributed structure model of economic financial management data storage is constructed, and the encrypted statistical characteristics of economic financial management data are extracted. The homomorphism data fusion method is used to deal with the fuzzy clustering of economic and financial management data, and the fuzzy C-means clustering method is combined to carry out the piecewise fusion scheduling of economic and financial management data. The chaotic arithmetic coding scheme is used to design the economic financial management data storage encryption in the segmented interval, and the encryption key and decryption key are constructed based on piecewise fusion encryption and information clustering. Realize the multi-level distributed storage design of economic financial management database. The simulation results show that the distributed storage and encryption design of economic financial management data is well integrated, the ability of anti-deciphering is strong, and the security of economic and financial management data is improved.

articleTitle: Design of Practical Information Multidimensional Integration System for Higher Vocational Ideological and Political Courses Facing Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the fact that the current information integration system can not quickly integrate a large number of chaotic practical information, this paper designs a multi-dimensional integration system of practical information for ideological and political courses in higher vocational colleges. The main control chip, TMS320C6748, is used to control the whole operation of the system. The physical server stores the information data and communicates with the serial port to transfer the data. Through the method of FPGA, the cluttered practical information data is filtered. According to the principle of Bayesian algorithm, the filtered information data is classified and the information data is preprocessed. In the SQL database, XML technology is used to parse and transform the pre-processed information and data. The data transformed into XML format is unified. According to the set multi-dimensional integration rules, data streams are split in the middle layer of the database and then merged is omorphically and heterogeneously. The data is loaded and stored in the integrated database, and finally the integration of information and data is completed. The design of multi-dimensional integration system is completed through hardware and software design. Comparing with the current information integration system, the experiment verifies the speed of information integration time of the designed multi-dimensional integration system. When integrating different amounts of practical information, the integration time of the designed multi-dimensional integration system is about one third of that of the current information integration system.

Author Keywords: higher vocational ideological and political course

articleTitle: Construction of Visual Communication Teaching Mode Based on Improved Mobile Search Algorithm in Internet + Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: When using the traditional algorithm for graph mobile search in the Internet+ environment, the result is not accurate due to the lack of a strict standard. The size and position of the graphic display cannot be effectively determined, and it is difficult to effectively support the graphical mobile search control. Therefore, a new mobile communication learning algorithm in visual communication teaching mode is proposed. The display size of the buffer image in the visual communication teaching mode is calculated by the fixed value method. The minimum value of the search layout and the highest value of the surface utilization are used as the search objective function. The ant colony algorithm is used to solve the problem and the optimal solution is obtained. Get the best display position of the graphics in the visual communication teaching mode. The description of the graphics movement is implemented by a grammatical description according to the rules and a semantic description according to ASM (abstract stale machine). The parallel flow and selection identification are used to describe the parallel flow and selection process of graphic movement in the visual communication teaching mode, and the parallel movement and selection process are used to realize the automatic movement of graphic movement. The program is written and run by C language to achieve the purpose of automatic graph movement. The experimental results show that the user satisfaction of the proposed algorithm is 7.792, which is significantly higher than the traditional algorithm, indicating that the proposed algorithm has better search effect and higher practical value.

articleTitle: Node Localization Algorithm Based on 3D Grid Partition and Meanshift Iteration for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: A MeanShift-based node localization algorithm in three-dimensional grid environment is proposed to solve the problem of wireless sensor network node positioning accuracy. The algorithm embeds the data objects into the three-dimensional space divided into grid cells, which uses a density threshold to identify the dense units and finds the density-based clusters in the grid cells. MeanShift algorithm is used to calculate the optimal solution of probability density and achieve the accurate location of nodes. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the average relative positioning accuracy of nodes compared with 3D-DV-Hop algorithm and 3D-WD-DV-Hop algorithm, with the increase of the total number of nodes and communication radius.

articleTitle: A Distribution of Suspended Sediment Concentration in Muddy Coast, China
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The muddy coast with fine cohesive sediment particles is an important form in the coastal area of our country. Sediment on the bottom of muddy coast start and enter the upper water body under the action of shear force caused by wave and tidal current, and then, advect and diffuse to the surrounding area in the main form of suspended sediment along with the tidal current. Many important ports in china are located on the muddy coast, so it is necessary to study the distribution of suspended sediment concentration, an important criterion of siltation of harbor and navigational channel. The study area involved in this paper is Lianyungang, a typical muddy coast in Northeast of Jiangsu Province, in where the terrain is gentle and parallel to the coastline. In this article, the hydrodynamic and sediment environment under different wind and wave conditions of Lianyungang are analyzed. The following main conclusions are drawn from the study. (1) Plane distribution law of suspended sediment concentration in Lianyungang area generally shows higher nearshore and lower offshore. (2) In normal weather, the vertical average suspended sediment concentration in Lianyungang is between 0.10~0.15kg/m3, while the annual average value is between 0.20~0.50kg/m3. (3) The typhoon "Wipha" makes the wave larger and the scouring effect on the nearshore stronger, so the value of suspended sediment concentration increases sharply and several times higher.

articleTitle: Research on the Relation between Environmental Protection and Industrial Development
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, how to effectively and scientifically develop energy, reduce the probability of environmental pollution, and reduce the frequency of safety accidents have become the focus of our society. In addition, the formulation and implementation of environmental protection policies can not only improve the quality of the environment, but also improve the living standards of the people, which has become the focus of our society. At the same time, China's chemical industry value chain continues to develop, which is a good thing for the entire national economy. However, at present, in many small and medium-sized enterprises, especially in chemical enterprises, environmental pollution is becoming more and more serious, so it is imperative to protect the environment.
