In addition, for enterprises, especially chemical enterprises, it is an urgent and important task to build a scientific and perfect safety management system, establish safety awareness, improve the management level of environmental protection departments, and take reasonable and scientific countermeasures to solve environmental problems.

articleTitle: Research of the Cow Body Evaluation System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high labor cost, slow feedback speed in the traditional cow raising and management, a design method of intelligent dairy farming is proposed, Internet of things + animal husbandry. By exploring the Internet of things technology, combining sensor technology, artificial neural network technology and machine learning method, the method analyzes the behavioral physiology mechanism and behavior change characteristics of cows, and studies the automatic and intelligent method of individual information acquisition of cows. Through theoretical analysis, numerical simulation and experimental research, the experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce the cost of monitoring and improve the accuracy of monitoring.

articleTitle: Application of Finite Element Simulation Method in Measurement of Zinc Plasma Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The plasma is called the fourth state of matter, which has many different properties from solid, liquid and gaseous. These properties can be widely used in the field of low temperature plasma. In the field of low temperature plasma, there are material surface modification, medicine and so on. We use the emission spectrometer avantes 2048L to enter the density of zinc plasma at atmospheric pressure. It is found that with the increase of input power, the electron temperature and density increase gradually, but the spectral intensity decreases accordingly. Then we use the finite element electromagnetic simulation software HFSS to analyze the electromagnetic distribution of plasma jet, and find that the electromagnetic wave on the plasma surface is traveling wave.

articleTitle: Spatial and Temporal Variation Characteristics of Precipitation in North Canal Basin From 1960 to 2016
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The temporal and spatial variation characteristics of precipitation in the basin are obtained by analyzing the precipitation data from 1960 to 2016 in the North Canal. The results show that: (1) The annual precipitation in the North Canal Basin has a weak downward trend as a whole, and there are alternating rising and falling characteristics between years. Uneven distribution during the year, precipitation is mainly concentrated in June to August, the average precipitation during this period accounted for 72% of the year; (2) The spatial distribution of precipitation in the basin is generally the most precipitation in the middle reaches, followed by the upper mountainous areas and the lower plains; In the seasons, the precipitation in the upper reaches of the summer is higher than that in the lower plains, and the opposite is true in winter. (3) The precipitation variation of the Northern Canal Basin is obvious, and the mutation point appeared in 1996 in the mid-1990s. This time node is consistent with the large regional pattern change of the Haihe River Basin; The periodic analysis shows that there are three periods of "bump-dry" change in the North Canal watershed, and the six oscillations on the 8-17a time scale are the most stable and significant, and the first main period is 13a.

articleTitle: Optimum Design of Digital Signal Processing System for Soldier Reconnaissance Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Digital signal processing system is the key component of single-soldier reconnaissance radar to advance moving target in strong ground clutter background. In this paper, combined with the actual working environment of the single-soldier reconnaissance radar, the transmitted signal of the transmitting system directionally coupled is beat, and the signal after beat contains the distance and velocity information of the target. Through the two-dimensional analysis of the beat signal, the distance and Doppler information of the target can be obtained. This method is simple and effective, and greatly improves the probability of acquiring information of moving targets.

articleTitle: Optimization Evaluation of Student Satisfaction in Discipline Construction Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at evaluating the student satisfaction in discipline construction scientifically and effectively, an optimization evaluation method of student satisfaction in discipline construction based on information entropy and principal component analysis is proposed. The influencing factors of student satisfaction are obtained by using literature method and multivariate statistical analysis. These influence factors take into account both generality and individuality in different disciplines. Due to the number of influence factors is too large, the calculation burdens in evaluation need to be considered. Therefore, comprehensive determinants of students' satisfaction in discipline construction are defined in this paper. Comprehensive determinants of students' satisfaction in discipline construction are defined to be teachers' conditions, teaching conditions and practical conditions by principal component analysis method. Weights of comprehensive determinants in optimization evaluation are computed by entropy weight method. The experimental results verify the validity and feasibility of the optimization evaluation method of student satisfaction in discipline construction proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Sentiment Classification of Active Scene Images Based on DNN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the development of computer and communication technology, more and more activity scene design images have been digitized. In order to solve the problem of automatic classification of such scene images, this paper proposes a multi-featured activity scene image sentiment classification method. This research analyzed the relationship between color features (artistic style) and emotional semantics and established the activity scene image data base. According to the characteristics of the scene image. It extracted the global and local color features based on the characteristics of the scene image and completed the sentiment classification of the activity scene image with classifier of deep neural network.

articleTitle: An AHP Method with Cosmetic Design Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the circulation of global brands has become a common trend, a design development of ultra thin cosmetic product to make the product size easier to circulate and with better temperature tolerance, bacteria resistance and antiknock quality. Furthermore, with this method, products are able to cater for the growing international market and also adapt to the rapidly changing fashion environment. Thus the application for ultra thin powder is characterized by small volume of a large variety production. Along with changes in fashion, automated production was used to create fashion and luxury goods suited for consumers. Moreover, it makes the products portable, and the price reasonable that meets the demand of consumers. The design of the study was used as a criterion to verify the production result while AHP method was adopted to calculate the optimal size in design target. In the final stage of the study, empirical verification is conducted. The experimental results show that the proposed method has efficiency, which lays a foundation for the further AHP and ANP application in practice.

articleTitle: Monitoring Research on the Ground Deformation from InSAR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to reduce the potential damage which caused by ground deformation occur frequently and threatened people's production and life directly or indirectly in the urban city, it is very necessary to monitor ground deformation thoroughly and accurately. The persistent scatterer pair interferometric synthetic aperture radar (PSP-InSAR) method were used to analyze land deformation of the high-resolution COSMO-SkyMed Himage images collected from February 2013 to January 2018 in the Chancheng district of Foshan city. Then the warning threshold and the potential region were selected after the ground deformation tendency, location and rangeability were analyzed. Moreover, among the detected 1765521 PS points, 4143 points with ≥-18mm/year deformation rate were determined. Results show that the overall geological condition is stable, but some local areas remain dangerous. It is necessary to reinforce the prevention and management of regional geological disasters.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Public Transit Timetable Considering Transfer Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: this study focuses on transit timetable problem considering transfer synchronization for those routes with large frequency and deterministic travel time. The objective of this research is to minimize total travel time experienced by all passengers. A homogeneous headway-based mathematical model was presented for addressing transfer synchronization problem, as well as an improved genetic algorithm (GA). The case study showed: (a) the addition of elitism and Piecewise evolutionary strategy help GA search best solution quickly as well as keep higher convergence, (b) initial wait time and transfer wait time keep a cooperative relationship in transfer synchronization problem, and (c) in-vehicle travel time of passenger keep a competitive relationship with wait time.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Regional Health Information Collection Transmission and Integration System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the further development of Internet of Things technology, the highly integrated IoT communication technology has been widely used. The wearable device has been transformed from concept to actual product, and has also begun to develop into the medical industry, such as wrist blood glucose controller, sound wave. Stimulating insulin secretors, wearable defibrillators, wearable alternating electric fields for brain tumor treatment, iontophoresis, smart glasses to help people with Alzheimer's disease find items. Based on the Internet of Things technology, the conditions for establishing a regional health service system from residents (bottom floor) to medical institutions (top level) are becoming more and more mature. The content of this research institute will also be widely applied and promoted in regional residents' health services.

articleTitle: Research on Ontology Semantic Similarity Analysis Model of Deep Learning Mode Under Grid Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low semantic recognition rate and inaccurate analysis in traditional ontology semantic similarity analysis, an ontology semantic similarity analysis method for deep learning mode under grid platform is proposed. The proposed method firstly combines the grid platform and deep learning to construct the ontology semantic analysis model, and then repeatedly trains the ontology semantic samples through the deep learning training mechanism, adjusts the parameters of the model, reconstructs the analysis model, and enables the computer to better understand the ontology. The semantic meaning, at the same time set the interrelationship between the ontology, and finally through the design of the software verification analysis model, the verification results show that the proposed ontology semantic analysis model can effectively improve the efficiency of analysis.

articleTitle: Reflections on the Cultivation System of Innovative Talents in Universities in the era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of overcoming the deep dilemma and changing trend brought by the coming of intelligent age to the cultivation of innovative talents, this paper proposes an innovative education framework system under the artificial intelligence environment and an innovative teaching system of human-computer cooperation in colleges. These systems take the cultivation of innovative talents in the modernization of education as an important goal, analyze the cultivation of innovative personality, the generation of creative thinking, the improvement of innovative ability and the construction of innovative knowledge of college students. These factors are based on the idea that the cultivation of innovative talents in colleges and universities should turn to the construction of cultivating students' innovative subject knowledge with the help of the ability of intelligent equipment. Finally, the function and role of teachers in the stage of wisdom education are proposed. The results show that the teaching systems improve the teaching effect in college training practice.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Modulation Method of Tunable Diode Pulse Width Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In that intelligent detection process of the pulse width of the tunable diode, a tunable diode pulse width intelligent modulation system based on the 80C51 single-chip microcomputer is designed, the amplitude compensation of the tunable diode pulse width spectrum is analyze, the pulse width of the tunable diode is calculated, And the positioning and identifying capability of the adjustable diode pulse width is improved. The intelligent modulation design of the tunable diode pulse width is carried out by an improved FIR filter algorithm, and the modulation and demodulation processing is carried out according to the input data of the current broadband tuning circuit to realize the intelligent modulation of the tunable diode pulse width based on the 80C51 single chip microcomputer. The experimental results show that the self-adaptive performance of the tunable diode pulse width modulation is good, the broadband back wave detection capability is strong, the signal filtering performance is good, the pulse width identification capability of the tunable diode is improved, the detection accuracy is improved by 14.5%, The intelligent modulation and processing performance of the better tunable diode pulse width is shown.

articleTitle: The Method of Construction Knowledge Triples Under Joint Extraction of Entity Relations Based on Distant Supervision
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of cascading mistakes and overlap relation problems in the current methods of relation extraction. A joint entity relation extraction method based on Bert is proposed. In this method, Bert and bilstm are adopted, and attention mechanism is introduced to improve the existing HRL model. By replacing the traditional word2vec word vector with Bert, richer semantic information is considered. The attention mechanism is introduced to consider the dependence between words on the basis of bilstm. At last, entity relation is extracted and entity relation triples are output. The experimental result shows that this method can deal with the overlap relation well and improve the result obviously. Experiments on the NYT10 dataset show that the proposed method has higher accuracy and recall rate. Compared with the latest joint extraction method, the P, R, and F1 values are increased by 5.2%, 4.6%, and 4.86%.

Author Keywords: Distant supervision Relation extraction Attention BERT

articleTitle: Impact Characteristics Simulation Analysis of High Pressure Valve Based on Workbench/ls-Dyna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to analysis stress and strain changes with time which the cone valve rod impact seat when the valve is closed, to prevent excessive stress due to the impact of fatigue damage, two calculation models(Elastic-rigidimpact;Elastic-elastic impact) are researched which the cone valve rod and valve seat impact respectively when the valve is closed by using the nonlinear dynamics software workbench/ls-dyna, and the effects of closing speed and contact uniformity on the calculation results are analyzed and studied, the results show that: uneven impact stress is greater than the positive impact of stress, easy to make the valve failure; the stress of elastic-rigid impact is greater than that of the elastic-elastic impact each other; The stress between valve core and valve increases as the velocity increases when the elastic-elastic impact each other. To provide a reference and basis for the structural modification and optimization design of the high pressure valve.

Author Keywords: high temperature and high pressure valve

articleTitle: Research on Data Storage System of E-Commerce Purchasing Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The storage of e-commerce procurement data is randomly distributed, which is interfered by the characteristic quantity of neighborhood distribution state, resulting in insufficient query performance. In order to improve the automatic location and storage ability of e-commerce procurement data, an automatic location and storage method of e-commerce procurement data based on big data technology is proposed. The distributed adaptive storage structure model of e-commerce procurement data is constructed, and the multivariate feature mining of e-commerce procurement data is carried out by using the method of regional grid computing, and the high dimension characteristic quantity of e-commerce procurement data is extracted. Combined with phase space reconstruction method, the storage space structure of e-commerce procurement data is reorganized, and big data mining and spectral feature extraction technology are used to realize the knowledge connection of e-commerce procurement data, and the automatic location storage optimization is realized. The simulation results show that the load of automatic location storage of e-commerce procurement data is large, the storage capacity is improved, and the real-time access ability of e-commerce procurement data is better.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evaluation Model of Intelligent Gymnasium Service Resources Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve that dynamic evaluation and the sharing capability of the intelligent stadium service resource, a dynamic evaluation model design method of the intelligent stadium service resource based on large data is proposed, and an information fusion model for dynamic evaluation of the service resources of the intelligent stadium is constructed, The distributed storage structure of the intelligent stadium service resource is analyzed, the large database reconstruction of the intelligent stadium service resource is realized by adopting the cloud computing method, a characteristic reconstruction method is adopted to carry out the dynamic evaluation design of the intelligent stadium service resources, And a cloud computing model for dynamically evaluating the service resources of the intelligent stadium is established. By adopting the method of large data fusion to realize the dynamic evaluation of the service resources of the intelligent stadium and the stadium, the dynamic correlation dimension extraction of the intelligent stadium service resource information base is realized by combining the self-correlation characteristic matching method, and the optimization design of the intelligent stadium service resource dynamic evaluation platform is realized. The simulation results show that the method can be used to evaluate the dynamic evaluation of the intelligent stadium service resources, and the accuracy of the evaluation is higher, and the dynamic evaluation ability of the intelligent stadium service resources is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Evaluation Index System of Agricultural Professional Managers for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The application of big data technology in agriculture is the core development direction to realize the maximum utilization of agricultural data information. It is an important task to cultivate high-quality agricultural talents to promote the sustainable and rapid development of intelligent agriculture. Based on the demand side and supply side of intelligent agricultural education system, the big data platform of evaluation index system for professional agricultural managers is constructed. Firstly, this paper studies the application of big data technology in the evaluation index system. Then a rational and effective evaluation index system of agricultural professional managers is constructed by using the network analytic hierarchy process and the grey theory model.

Author Keywords: evaluation index system, professional manager, big data, intelligent agriculture

articleTitle: Research on the Theory Model of Movement Commitment in the Movement of Different Time Structures in Sports Training
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to monitor the effects of different levels of structural level exercise training, this paper proposes a method of different time structure level sports training in the Model of Motion Commitment Theory (MMCT). By using the statistical basis to measure the difference of motion in different time periods, in the process of monitoring the motion commitment theory model, the unmarked samples can be effectively marked by the motion commitment theory model, and the unlabeled samples are passed through the classifier. Confidence level is used to estimate the confidence level. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm enhances the standardization, institutionalization and scientificization of sports training monitoring, and provides a scientific theoretical basis for the establishment of sports time science.

articleTitle: Design and Research of University International Cooperation Office Platform Based on SSM Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the tedious formalities for university students to study abroad and the difficulties in promoting overseas study projects, this paper proposes a semi-automatic management system for university students to study abroad based on the agile development process model and the framework of Spring, Spring MVC and MyBatis. Starting with product business process design, product logic architecture design and product entity class design, it has realized that the person in charge of the Institute of International Education publishes projects, pushes information, screens students, examines and approves applications, formulates procedures, processes for leaving school, returns to school, receives consultation, receives registration and maintains information, etc., and students browse projects and do business. The system has been successfully delivered after testing and acceptance. The experimental results show that the international educational cooperation platform can realize the daily management of exchange students and the promotion and publicity of international cooperation projects, and make the process of students studying abroad standardized and systematic.

articleTitle: Application Research of Stem Education in Big Data + Math Core Literacy Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To study the STEM education of college students in the big data environment, to guide the college students to improve the core literacy of mathematics, and then to improve the core literacy of college students. Using the big data gain to analyze the correlation between the influencing factors and the frequency of STEM education, build sensitive Influencing factors model, and further using Big Data + Math Core Literacy Cultivation (BDMCLCM) to establish a big data + math core literacy training model. The 10 influencing factors most relevant to the occurrence of STEM education are distributed in the breeding object, encounter big data, big data environment The core literacy of mathematics is 4 dimensions; the accuracy of model classification prediction is 82.96%, which indicates that BDMCLCM has a good effect on predicting the frequency of STEM education.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Image Reconstruction Method Based on Real-Time Fusion Technology of VR and AR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The unknown pixel points are unknown due to the prior information loss, the block feature matching and the boundary structure feature information, and the blurred image restoration is difficult. In the traditional method, the edge contour feature matching multi-scale decomposition method is adopted to perform the fuzzy image restoration, the matching degree of the information template is not high, and the fuzzy image restoration effect is not good. The invention introduces a VR and AR real-time fusion algorithm, and provides a multi-feature distribution fuzzy image restoration algorithm based on VR and AR real-time fusion technology and brightness compensation, The image enhancement process is performed and then matrix expansion is performed on the extracted fine features to maintain the continuity of the image miss area being restored. The image micro-decomposition model of VR and AR real-time fusion algorithm is constructed, and the image information recovery improvement to the edge contour feature points is realized by combining the edge feature lighting degree compensation strategy. The experimental results show that the algorithm has good visual effect, less recovery time and computational overhead, and improves the stability and convergence of the fuzzy image, and the signal-to-noise ratio error after the image restoration is less than 4%, and the performance is superior.

articleTitle: Exploring the Participatory Practice Teaching of Visual Communication Design Based on Information Quality Education Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Visual communication design conveys information to audiences through visual symbols and influences. However, due to the rapid development of digital communication and multimedia technology, the practice of visual communication design practice faces broad development prospects and challenges. To this end, a dependency information is proposed. The visual communication design method of quality education model. In order to ensure the efficiency and security of the information literacy education model, the hierarchical structure of the information literacy education model is designed through visual communication design, and the visual image is analyzed based on visual communication in the three-dimensional environment, and each part of the data information can be obtained, thereby constructing The information literacy education model; according to the information literacy education model, the visual communication and high-quality virtual rendering are designed, and the practical teaching is analyzed from the perspective of visual communication, thereby obtaining the new design talent under the "Internet +". The experimental results show that the information quality education model can better serve the visual communication practice teaching.

articleTitle: The Application of Stereo Image Generation and Composition Algorithms in Desktop-Based Virtual Reality Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Education is the foundation of a country's development. However, some areas in our country are more backward, while others are more prosperous. The educational level in these areas is different. Some remote areas are backward in education level and lack of educational resources, and the education sector invests very little in these areas. With the advent of the era of virtual reality, people begin to apply virtual reality technology to various fields. Although the application of these virtual reality technology is only the beginning, it also shows great advantages, which makes the education environment and conditions of the 21st century change dramatically. With the continuous progress of virtual reality technology, it is organically combined with the field of education. Compared with traditional education model, virtual education model has special advantages. Virtual educational environment, which is based on virtual reality technology and combined with the field of education, is not only the real display of the real world, but also the presentation of the virtual world. In this paper, the application of virtual reality technology in teaching system is analyzed and discussed from two perspectives of stereo image generation and synthesis algorithm.

articleTitle: Time Reversal Block Diagonalization for Spatial Multiplexing MIMO-UWB
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the traditional multi-user MIMO, the number of independent sub-channels is associated with the number of receive antennas and the transmit antennas. We propose a method based on time reversed and block diagonalization used for spatial multiplexing MIMO-UWB system. By involving time reversed technology, the joint optimization of pre-and post-coders will be simplified to the problem of optimize one of them (pre-or post-coders). With such an encoder, we can apply eigenvalue decomposition to the channel impulse response matrix, and make it be diagonal to eliminate MSI completely. Consider the optimization of the transmission power allocation associated with the diagonalization mentioned above. We also present a MIMO-UWB system to transmit independent multi-stream. Simulation results show that the MIMO-TR-BD method can improve the system (BER) performance.

articleTitle: Study on Ground Deformation Influenced by Subway Construction and Operation using InSAR Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to reinforce the monitoring work of ground deformation around subway construction and operation which extremely affects the ground deformation and influences the surrounding environment, even that causes accidents, the interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) technique which are always deal with the massive data in the area of land deformation were used to analyze the high-resolution COSMO-SkyMed Himage images acquired from February 2013 to September 2018 around subway line in Hefei city. The results and conclusions indicate that subway construction and operation in Hefei obviously influenced ground settlement and deformation, especially for the areas around line 4, intersections of line 1 with line 4 and line 5, and the interchange station of line 1 and line 2. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the prevention and management work of regional geological disasters.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Cracking Design Method of Steel-Concrete Composite Beams in Negative Moment Zone
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Steel-concrete composite girder bridges have been widely used in practical engineering because they can make full use of the two materials and have unique advantages. However, the negative bending moment produced by the fulcrum of steel-concrete composite continuous beam bridge is very easy to cause cracking of concrete deck. At present, the common design method is to pre-stress the concrete deck at the fulcrum by dropping the beam, so as to prevent the cracking of concrete deck. Based on ABAQUS finite element software, this paper establishes the full bridge model of the real bridge project and simulates the falling beam construction. The results show that the simulation method can better simulate the drop beam condition of steel-concrete composite beam, and the drop beam condition can effectively prevent the cracking of concrete bridge deck at the fulcrum; with the increase of the drop beam height, the pre-compressive stress of concrete bridge deck at the fulcrum shows a significant increase trend; through analysis, the drop beam height of 50cm is determined for this practical project, which provides a rationality for similar projects.

articleTitle: Construction of International Trade Information Remote Sharing Platform Based on Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing common information sharing platform has a long response time to instantaneous massive data processing, a remote information sharing platform for international trade is constructed by using cloud technology. Using cloud technology to build platform infrastructure layer, virtualize physical servers, and manage data in the cloud through database. Users call the data in the resource pool through the resource management unit to realize the remote sharing of information, and finally complete the construction of the international trade information remote sharing platform. Comparing with common shared platform, the experiment is carried out. The experimental results show that when dealing with instantaneous large amounts of data, the response time of the remote sharing platform is on average half of that of the common platform, which can realize the remote sharing of large amounts of data in a shorter time.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an Integrated Multi-service Monitoring Platform for Mine Safety
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of the traditional monitoring methods and systems in coal-mining industry, this paper deeply explores the resources of the GENE-8310 embedded industrial control board, and proposes an integrated multi-service monitoring platform which integrates the IP-based communications of video, voice and data. This paper introduces the architecture principle of this platform, hardware design and detailed definition of related modules firstly. Then through the simulation test of the simulation platform in the laboratory, it is proved that the platform can realize the design objective that all the services under the mine is IP-based.

articleTitle: The Marxist Chinese Political Teaching Innovation Model Based on Multimedia Database Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to explore the feasibility and necessity of promoting the innovation model of Marxism in China based on multimedia database management system, this paper studies the selection of the "office network information technology" course as an example to carry out the practice of the innovative model of political teaching in China. The research process includes identifying and defining learning needs, formulating learning plans and evaluation strategies, designing and developing Marxist Chinese politics, implementation planning and evaluation, and using SPSS and other tools to analyze data such as learning behaviors, learning outcomes, and questionnaires. The results show that well-designed Marxist Chinese politics can effectively improve the quality of teaching; students' online learning behavior is positively correlated with academic achievement; students' acceptance and satisfaction with Marxist Chinese politics are high.

articleTitle: Construction of Music Pronunciation Quality Theory Evaluation Model Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The research on the construction of evaluation model of music pronunciation quality theory has always been a hot topic. Music pronunciation quality has a direct impact on the reliability of assessment results. Traditional methods of music pronunciation quality analysis mainly analyze the pronunciation problem of music through the statistical index, but the statistical index cannot In order to improve the quality of detecting music, this paper presents a theory model of evaluating the quality of music pronunciation based on the fusion of artificial intelligence technology. Under the premise of meeting the interval constraints, according to the pronunciation theory of music The sample generated artificial intelligence tree, and evaluated the quality of music pronunciation according to artificial intelligence tree. Finally, the validity, the efficiency and the scalability of the model were verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Network Topology Optimization of UAV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the emphasis on effective utilization of UAV of the national interests, the upsurge in UAV formation cooperative application development and the rapid development of Ad Hoc network application research, UAV network has become a new hot research area. In this paper, aiming at the particularity of UAV network and various possible situations in practical application, the topology adjustment and optimization scheme of UAV under encountering occlusion, in case of UAV failure, communication coverage adjustment, three circumstances is proposed, and the detailed design is carried out, which provides certain reference for the development of UAV technology towards the direction of clustering, intelligence and networking.

articleTitle: Design of Flash Point and Ignition Point Virtual Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Some dangerous experimental operations exist in the experimental teaching of flash point and ignition point. Based on the soft UNITY-3D, the flash point and ignition point virtual teaching system is designed by via of understanding of the experiment procedure. The 3D model of the instruments is completed firstly, secondly imported these models into UNITY-3d to construct the virtual scene, thirdly, the user interface is designed, it is divided into five modules: experimental overview, experimental instrument introduction, experimental demonstration, ignition experiment, and flash point experiment. Animated with animation and voice. Finally, the program script is written in C# language to mobilize the experimental instrument and finally complete the virtual experiment. Through the teaching system, the students learned the principle of flash point and flash point measurement, and mastered the experimental measurement method to avoid the danger in the actual experiment.

articleTitle: The Line Dance Movement and Folk Dance Culture Evolution Model Based on Ultra-Gradient Fuzzy Rules
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the problems that current existing line dance movement and folk dance culture evolution models are time-consuming and computationally inefficient, this article proposes the line dance movement and folk dance culture evolution model based on ultra-gradient fuzzy rules. It ranks the line dance movement and folk dance cultures according to their evolutionary characteristics, establishes an evolution model based on the ultra-gradient fuzzy rules; then uses the local optimization schemes to add elite samples or delete weaker samples to the selected feature sets. It gradually conducts optimization operations during the evolution process of the line dance movement and folk dance cultures to reduce the overall computational costs. Finally, comparative experiments show that: the evolution quality and speed of the line dance movement and folk dance cultures of this model are better than those of other models, and can maintain better diversity in the evolution process of line dance movement and folk dance cultures.

articleTitle: The Application and Research of MOOC Teaching in Accounting Profession Under the Background of "Internet +"
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the development and progress of the Internet, more and more high-tech has been applied to the field of higher education in China. Among them, accounting major in Chinese universities is a typical example. With the development and popularization of science and technology, accounting major in Colleges and universities is facing enormous challenges and opportunities. At the same time, the main cause of this reform phenomenon is the emergence of MOOC. Moreober, starting with the concept of MOOC, this paper analyses the main characteristics of MOOC and explores its advantages in the teaching of accounting major in Contemporary Colleges and universities. In addition, the author hopes this paper can give some reference to other scholars.

articleTitle: Software Design of Automatic Parking Robot Based on Flat Stereo Garage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to meet the urgent needs of the robot of automatic vehicle in the flat three-dimensional garage, this paper introduces a new type of plane-type heavy-duty automatic handling robot, which is independently developed by our company and has functions such as driving along fixed paths, autonomous navigation, secondary anti-collision, sound and light alarm. It is characterized by a significant load and can be used for automatic handling of all household models of 2.5t and below. Fast speed, up to a top speed of 3m/s. Spin in place, no need to set a turning radius, so that the garage layout is more tightly, car density than ordinary garage can be increased by 65%. Automatically find and charge the charging bit, working 24 hours a day. By my company in-field and test site for a long time repeated verification, the robot work condition is stable, high efficiency, low failure rate, each flat three-dimensional garage configuration 3-5 automatic handling robot, can greatly improve the use and operation efficiency of the entire garage, greatly improve the economic and social benefits of the garage.

articleTitle: Construction of Mobile Network Education Data Analysis Platform Based on Distributed Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient precision of traditional network education data analysis platform, a mobile network education data analysis platform based on distributed architecture is proposed. Firstly, the distributed architecture principle and feature collection algorithm are combined to collect and divide the relevant data in network education. According to the collected data, the data analysis framework in the platform is optimized so as to analyze different levels of characteristic data in different modules and avoid problems such as information congestion. Finally, the mobile network education data analysis platform with distributed architecture is constructed. Finally, the experiment proves that the mobile network education data analysis platform based on distributed architecture has higher accuracy than the traditional data analysis platform.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Satisfaction Model of Counselor's Ideological and Political Education Combining Fuzzy Decision
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The method of fuzzy mathematics is introduced to evaluate the teaching satisfaction of the ideological and political education by the counselors. In accordance with the steps for the construction of the model, the model variables are set and the fuzzy mathematics theory is conceptualized. Combined with specific cases, the survey data are obtained, and empirical study is carried out on the fuzzy mathematics theory. The parameters are estimated and fitted by using the AMOS20.0 to determine the fuzzy mathematics theory after the evaluation coefficient is standardized. This model is used to make quantitative analysis on the customer satisfaction of the ideological and political education by the counselors, which is conducive for the counselors taking the corresponding measures to improve the student satisfaction on the ideological and political education and increase the work level and service quality of the ideological and political education construction.

articleTitle: Measurement of Core Permeability in "Reservoir Physics" by Virtual Simulation Experiment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Using OpenCV image processing library and VC++ programming language, this paper realizes the virtual simulation experiment measurement of core permeability of "Reservoir Physics". The permeability measurements of several core samples were completed, the experimental data were recorded dynamically, and the experimental data points were fitted linearly. Resource sharing is realized, the cost of the experiment is saved and minimize the risk factors in the real experiment that needs to be completed next. By guiding students to complete virtual simulation experiments before class, teachers can more actively cultivate students' learning initiative and enable students to complete real experiments with questions. Virtual simulation experiment is a new teaching mode completed by modern and contemporary technologies. It emphasizes the cultivation of talents' innovative ability, promotes the improvement of talents' quality and effectively improves the quality of running a school.

articleTitle: The Photo Task Pricing Based on Multi-objective Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This thesis establishes the functional relationship between the position, pricing and completion of the task, the position, reputation value of the member, the starting time and the reservation limit of the task given by referring to its reputation. In addition, this thesis also establishes multi-objective programming model and logistic regression model, and writes out the task pricing rule and designs the pricing scheme, realizes the model of obtaining the best pricing scheme by analyzing the task information and member information. Firstly, the data in the attachment are plotted, the outliers are removed and the error values are modified. In addition, by plotting the pre-processed data, we can extract the characteristics of the region and find out the various factors that affect the pricing law and the general relationship. At the same time, on the basis of theoretical analysis and data availability, this paper establishes a task pricing model by using multiple binomial regression algorithm, obtains the law of task pricing in Dongguan, Shenzhen and Guangzhou, and analyzes the reasons for the low completion rate of tasks. In addition, considering from the point of view of task publisher, we should not only make the order rate sufficiently high, but also make the order cost not too high. On this basis, the thesis puts forward a minimum-maximum bi-objective optimization model. In order to solve this model, this paper creatively puts forward the cost performance function, and designs the corresponding solving algorithm to solve the problem and give the pricing scheme. Finally, based on the consideration of jointly packaging and publishing tasks with similar distances, the multi-objective optimization model is adjusted, and two restrictions are given: the distance between packaged tasks is less than a fixed value, and the number of packaged tasks is less than a fixed value.

articleTitle: Study on PSIM Simulation of Parallel Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to suppress the harmonics in the power electronics, a method of SVPWM compensation current tracking based on dq transformation is proposed, which is simple to control and can accurately track the change of reference current, and this paper analyzes the working principle of parallel active power filter, main circuit structure, The command current operation circuit of DC side voltage control is included, and the simulation model is constructed by using PSIM 9.0. Through PSIM simulation verification, the method can effectively reduce the switching frequency of PWM converter and verify the advantages of this method.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Relationship between Mechanical and Electronic Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, the information technology of our country is also developing continuously, and applied to people's production and life. Therefore, various industries related to computer technology are gradually appearing in people's production and life, and artificial intelligence is one of them. In the field of mechanical and electronic engineering, we can often see the image of artificial intelligence, which can make full use of the powerful data processing performance of computers, thus solving many complex problems, and can also improve the automation level of mechanical and electronic engineering. In addition, in the 21st century, all countries around the world are striving to develop mechanical and electronic engineering, so as to improve their productivity level, but also to promote the development of mechanical and electronic engineering towards the direction of intellectualization, and also to promote its networking and flexibility. With the advent of the 21st century, mechanical and electronic engineering and artificial intelligence continue to be organically integrated. It can be predicted that in the coming decades, artificial intelligence will continue to integrate with mechanical and electronic engineering. This research mainly focuses on the relationship between mechanical and electronic engineering and artificial intelligence, and analyses the trend of their integration, hoping to forecast and provide theoretical support for their future trends.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm and Black-Scholes Option Pricing Model in Patent Value Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to avoid the traditional valuation method from underestimating the value of risk assets, this paper puts forward the similarity between option and patent, and puts forward the improved form of Black-Scholes option valuation model applied to patent value through reasonable assumption of patent. In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional algorithms, such as difficulty in solving nonlinear functions effectively, and difficulty in analyzing the effects of risk coefficient and variance of company assets on patent value, a genetic algorithm solving method for this problem is proposed. In order to effectively verify the function of this method, this paper simplifies it with an example. This method is relatively new. A practical example shows that the proposed model can be solved accurately based on genetic algorithm, and can also effectively judge the effect of the above two variables on patent value.

articleTitle: Research on Image Location Technology of Crop Diseases and Pests Based on Haar-Adaboost
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, video monitoring in greenhouses is used to obtain crop pictures and identify pests and diseases from crop pictures. The pictures obtained in video monitoring are not necessarily the "real" pictures containing crops. Haar-adaboost algorithm is used to judge whether the pictures obtained by video contain crops at first, and then identify them if they contain crops. If they do not, they will be extracted next time. The haar-adaboost algorithm proposed in this paper can realize high speed and effective positioning of crop pest images.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Visibility Judgment Algorithms Based on n-Fork Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this complex geometric environment, the graphical scene model tends to be diversified and complicated. To reduce the complexity of the model, it is necessary to make a fast visibility judgment before rendering the scene model and remove the important part of the real-time graphics display when the occluded elements are processed. A fast algorithm is proposed in this paper, which can deal with dynamic complex scenes. Real-time visibility judgment is made, and it is suitable for outdoor scenes with non-cavern structure. The algorithm organizes the whole scene with n-fork tree based on terrain using the idea of layering, and uses the double positioning method of linked list array to realize it. It not only saves the storage space effectively, but also locates the data nodes to be processed quickly, which greatly accelerates the process of view clipping and occlusion judgment.

Author Keywords: Virtual Reality, Graphic Scene Model, Visibility Judgment, View Clipping

articleTitle: The Path and Effect of Environmental Regulation on Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Starting from the basic problem of the impact of environmental regulations(ER) on carbon emissions(CE), this paper uses the provincial panel data from 2006 to 2016 to analyze the path and effect of ER on CE. First, we divide ER into direct environmental regulation tools(DER) and economic environmental regulation tools(EER), and empirically test the impact of different types of ER tools on CE. Then, we empirically examine the industrial structure effect, economic development effect and technological innovation effect of different types of ER on CE. The results show that ER not only has a direct effect on CE, but also indirectly affects CE through three paths: industrial structure, economic development and technological innovation. There is a negative correlation between ER and CE, and the CE reduction effect of DER is higher than that of EER. The industrial structure effects of DER and EER are negatively correlated with CE, but the economic development effects and technological innovation effects of the two ER tools are positively correlated with CE.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Information Integration of Agricultural Supply-Side Structural Reform in Heilongjiang Province Under the Framework of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of financial information integration in agricultural supply-side structural reform caused by existing technologies, this paper studies the financial information integration of agricultural supply-side structural reform in Heilongjiang province under the framework of big data. The web extraction model is used to extract financial information of agricultural supply-side structural reform in Heilongjiang province from various web pages, and the extracted XML data files are sorted to remove the repetitive financial information. The sorted financial information is mapped to the database according to the set mapping rules. Clustering algorithm is used to integrate financial information data in database. In order to verify the research effect of financial information data integration under big data architecture, a comparative experiment is conducted with traditional information integration. The experimental results show that the proposed financial information integration efficiency of agricultural supply-side structural reform in Heilongjiang province under the big data framework is nearly 30% higher than the traditional integration efficiency, which is more advantageous.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Intelligent Accounting in Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the progress and development of science, the combination of artificial intelligence and accounting has brought about the emergence of accounting intelligence technology, which enables robots to replace a large number of basic accounting personnel to work. It can be said that through in-depth simulation of human consciousness and thinking, accounting intellectualization can scientifically and effectively complete a series of regular, simple and repetitive work. However, with the acceleration of the process of accounting intellectualization, leading to the gradual replacement of middle and low-end financial personnel engaged in basic accounting work, but at the same time, the social demand for high-end financial personnel has gradually increased.

articleTitle: Construction of Big Data Hyperchaotic Mixed Encryption Model for Mobile Network Privacy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Big data of mobile network privacy is vulnerable to clear text attack in the process of storage and mixed network information sharing, which leads to information leakage. Through the mixed encryption of data of mobile network privacy big data to improve the confidentiality and security of mobile network privacy big data, a mobile network privacy big data hybrid encryption algorithm based on hyperchaos theory is proposed. The hybrid encryption key of mobile network privacy big data is constructed by using hyperchaotic nonlinear mapping hybrid encryption technology. Combined with the feature distribution of mobile network privacy big data, the mixed encrypted public key is designed by using Logistic hyperchaotic arrangement method, and a hyperchaotic analytic cipher and block cipher are constructed by using Rossle chaotic mapping. The random piecewise linear combination method is used to design the coding and key of mobile network privacy big data. According to the two-dimensional coding characteristics of mobile network privacy big data in the key authorization protocol, the hybrid encryption and decryption key of mobile network privacy big data is designed, and the mixed encryption and decryption key of mobile network privacy big data is constructed, Realize the privacy of mobile network big data mixed encryption output and key design. The simulation results show that this method has good confidentiality and strong steganography performance, which improves the anti-attack ability of big data, which is used to encrypt the privacy of mobile network.

articleTitle: Application of Multivariate Decision Analysis Algorithms in the Evaluation Index Body Model of Mathematics Teaching Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of all kinds of curriculum construction and Reform in Colleges and universities, the teaching mode based on working process has become the main mode of curriculum reform in most colleges and universities. In this paper, a method of building an evaluation index body model of mathematics teaching quality based on multiple decision analysis algorithm is proposed. Through the effective mining of the evaluation index system of teaching quality, the decision tree technology of fuzzy clustering is used to solve the irrationality in the current evaluation of teaching quality. When using the algorithm of multiple decision analysis, the evaluation conclusion is helpful for the evaluation index of mathematics teaching quality to achieve the goal of optimum evaluation. The results show that the evaluation index system and method system of mathematics teaching quality are constructed by using the theory of fuzzy mathematics and statistics, which is of great practical significance for strengthening the management of experiment teaching and promoting the improvement of experiment teaching quality.
